meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

howto.what: 给项目接入 DeltaChat 频道:Claude 会从 channels 分支取出适配器代码和注册测试、安装 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server、把邮件凭据写进 .env 并重启服务,让机器人通过端到端加密的邮件收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要求添加或接入 DeltaChat 频道时触发,或在跑 /setup 流程中接管;进入后按预检清单判断是否已装好,没装好才继续执行各步骤。

say.note: 会拉取适配器代码并安装依赖

howto.what_en: Claude adds a DeltaChat channel: it pulls the adapter and its registration test from the channels branch, installs @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server, writes email credentials to .env, and restarts the service so the bot exchanges end-to-end encrypted emails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add or integrate a DeltaChat channel, or during /setup. It first runs the idempotent pre-flight checks and only proceeds when the adapter is missing.

say_en.text: Add the DeltaChat channel to my project
say_en.note: Pulls the adapter code and installs the dependency

say_en.text: Show me the DeltaChat bot's invite link
say_en.note: Reads the invite URL from logs and the QR SVG

say_en.text: Wire a DeltaChat group to an agent
